answer: Put Endorsed pilgrimage guide licence with pilgrimage board confirmation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 754 identities means 754 fresh proofs and 89726 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. The quill of the design is public, the raven of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the sparrow of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
